entities.summary:
Sima Zhen, courtesy name Zizheng, was a Tang dynasty Chinese historian born in what is now Jiaozuo, Henan, in 661 CE. He became a renowned scholar and historian, renowned for his meticulous records and detailed accounts of Chinese history during the Tang dynasty. Sima Zhen's works include the famous 'Collection of Tang Poems' and the 'Collection of Tang Tales,' which provide valuable insights into the culture and society of the Tang dynasty.

Sima Zhen's significance lies in his contributions to Chinese historiography and literature, which have had a lasting impact on the field. His meticulous records and detailed accounts have served as a valuable resource for scholars and historians, providing a unique window into the culture and society of the Tang dynasty.

Despite his significant contributions, Sima Zhen's legacy has been somewhat overshadowed by that of his contemporaries, such as Du Fu and Li Bai. However, his works remain an important part of Chinese literary and historical heritage, providing a fascinating glimpse into the culture and society of the Tang dynasty.

Sima Zhen's life and works were marked by a commitment to accuracy and detail, which has made him one of the most respected historians of the Tang dynasty.
